note: Reserved purpose — `stepUp` is reserved, not defined in 0.2; the closed Purpose list must reject it.
Reserved mode — `push` is reserved, not defined in 0.2; the closed Mode list must reject it.
Missing mode — both purpose and mode are required.
Unknown member — additionalProperties: false rejects an endpoint smuggled into the request.
A requestId shorter than 22 characters carries fewer than 128 bits and must be rejected.
claimClosesAt is an RFC 3339 date-time; an integer count of seconds (the 0.1 `claimDeadline` form, the trigger link's `_exp` unit) is rejected.
